# Security

If you find a security problem on smail.org.sa or in this repo, please do not post it publicly.

Use the **Security** tab of this repo and choose **Report a vulnerability**, or email Saudimedicalailab@gmail.com with the subject "Security". Tell us what you found and how to reproduce it. We'll reply as soon as we can.

If you see a person's private details on the site and want them removed, email the same address.
